verdict.rationale: Groq's docs and early community benchmarks strongly support fast TTFT/high-throughput (streaming, service tiers, flex processing for 10x throughput, and independently verified 450+ tokens/sec on Mixtral/Llama), but more recent community reports concretely contradict this, describing Groq-hosted models as consistently slower/worse than other fast providers and citing frequent errors and poor performance-for-price. missing for 10: resolution of the conflicting recent performance complaints, first-party TTFT/throughput benchmarks with methodology, and consistency between early glowing reports and later negative experiences.
